summary.automatic_fail_reason: Red-team confirmed breach of all 4 critical objectives

findings.title: Entire API Completely Unauthenticated & Unauthorized — Every Endpoint Open to Anonymous Callers
findings.remediation: Add JWT bearer token middleware applied globally before all /api/* routes. Introduce RBAC with viewer/contributor/manager roles. Return 401 for unauthenticated requests and 403 for insufficient role before any business logic runs. Restrict /metrics to internal network.

findings.title: State Machine Bypass — Force-Approve With Zero Votes & No Authorization Check
findings.remediation: Gate force-approve and overrideRoute behind authenticated manager role (depends on CRIT-001 fix). Require minimum votes even for force-approve. Add audit log entry recording authenticated user identity and reason.

findings.title: Cross-User Dependency Injection → Ghost Blocker DoS on Victim Work Items
findings.remediation: Add FK ON DELETE CASCADE on dependencies.blocker_item_id. Enforce ownership: only item owner or admin may add dependencies to items they don't own. Remove dependency links when a blocker is soft-deleted.

findings.title: Pagination limit Parameter Entirely Ignored — Full Data Dump in One Unauthenticated Request
findings.remediation: Enforce max limit cap: const limit = Math.min(parseInt(req.query.limit) || 25, 100). Return proper PaginatedResponse<T> with page, limit, total, totalPages. Add integration test asserting ?limit=99999 returns at most 100 records.

findings.title: Unauthenticated Prometheus /metrics Exposure — Full Telemetry to Anonymous Callers
findings.remediation: Bind /metrics to 127.0.0.1 only, or use a separate internal-only HTTP server port. Alternatively add bearer token check using METRICS_TOKEN environment variable.

findings.title: Unauthenticated Webhook Intake — No HMAC Signature Verification
findings.remediation: Validate X-Zendesk-Webhook-Signature header using HMAC-SHA256 against shared secret in environment variables. Apply same shared-secret gating to /api/intake/automated. Reject with 401 before parsing body.

findings.title: No HTTP Security Headers — Missing Helmet, CORS Policy, CSP, HSTS
findings.remediation: npm install helmet cors in Source/Backend/. Add as first middleware: app.use(helmet()); app.use(cors({ origin: process.env.ALLOWED_ORIGINS?.split(',') ?? [] })). Configure HSTS for production.

findings.title: Required Audit Events Missing — login_attempt, permission_denied, data_export Not Logged
findings.remediation: Add login_attempt logging when auth is implemented. Add permission_denied logging in RBAC middleware. Add data_export log when result set exceeds 100 records. Tag state-transition logs with event: 'state_transition' key.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting on Any Endpoint — Brute Force, DoS & Injection Amplification
findings.remediation: Apply express-rate-limit: 100 req/min reads, 20 req/min writes, 10 req/min intake webhooks. Return Retry-After header with 429 responses.

findings.title: Body Size Overflow Returns 500 Instead of 413 Payload Too Large
findings.remediation: In errorHandler.ts, add: if (err.type === 'entity.too.large') { res.status(413).json({ error: 'Payload too large' }); return; }

findings.title: Cascade Auto-Dispatch via Blocker Rejection — No Human Gate or Authorization Check
findings.remediation: Add configuration flag to disable auto-dispatch cascades or require explicit confirmation. Log cascade with event: 'cascade_dispatch' including triggering item ID and actor identity.

findings.title: Unvalidated Enum Inputs in Intake Routes Allow Arbitrary type and priority Values
findings.remediation: Apply enum validation: if (body.type && !Object.values(WorkItemType).includes(body.type)) { res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid type value' }); return; }

findings.title: No TLS / HTTPS Enforcement — Backend Listens on Plain HTTP Only
findings.remediation: Add reverse proxy (nginx or Caddy) with TLS termination for production. Add HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect middleware. Document TLS setup in CLAUDE.md.

findings.title: No Schema Validation Library — Incomplete Injection Protection & No Field Length Limits
findings.remediation: Adopt Zod for schema validation across all request bodies. Add field-level maxLength constraints. Use express.json({ limit: '100kb' }) explicitly.

findings.title: Raw Internal Error Messages Returned to Clients in Workflow Routes
findings.remediation: Replace { error: message } with { error: 'Internal server error' } in all 500 responses in workflow.ts. Log message internally only.

findings.title: Plaintext Admin Credentials Checked Into CLAUDE.md
findings.remediation: Replace inline credentials with reference to .env.example. Add gitleaks to CI pre-commit hooks.

findings.title: No Hard-Delete / Data Erasure Mechanism — Future GDPR Art. 17 Risk
findings.remediation: Document in Specifications/ that a future persistence layer must include DELETE /api/work-items/:id/purge (privileged role only).

findings.title: Missing /api/search Route — Frontend DependencyPicker Non-Functional
findings.remediation: Implement GET /api/search?q=<query> filtering non-deleted work items by title or ID substring. Test contract already documented in Source/Backend/tests/routes/search.test.ts.

findings.title: Debug Portal iframe Missing sandbox Attribute
findings.remediation: Add sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin" to the iframe element. Gate page behind a build flag if dev-only.

grading.reason: Automatic F: red-teamer confirmed breach of all 4 critical objectives. 2 Critical confirmed findings. Compliance pass rate 9.5% (minimum for any passing grade is 60%).
